posts.text: PAX Global (0327.HK) reduced its annual dividend rate from 0.33 HKD to 0.08 HKD, a 75.8% cut. The company has maintained a dividend streak for 6 years.
CapLand Ascendas REIT (A17U.SI) raised its annual dividend rate by 36.4%, moving from 0.11 SGD to 0.15 SGD. This marks the company's first increase in its streak.
BAE Systems (BA.L) increased its annual dividend by 5.6% to 0.38 GBP. This extends the company's dividend growth streak to 21 consecutive years.
Texas Instruments ($TXN) raised its annual dividend rate to $6.08. The company hit an ex-dividend date of Oct 30, 2026, with a pay date of Nov 10.
Microsoft ($MSFT) increased its annual dividend by 7.7% to $3.92. The tech giant has now raised its dividend for 15 consecutive years.
Diageo plc ($DEO) cut its annual dividend rate by 39.8%, dropping from $3.32 to $2.00. The company is in its first year of a new dividend streak.
Dick's Sporting Goods ($DKS) leads the fast growers list with a 5-year dividend growth rate of 31.1%. The company has maintained a dividend streak for 11 years.
Clorox ($CLX) hit an ex-dividend date on Oct 28, 2026. The company has a 23-year dividend streak and a current yield of 5.72%.
